Though it is necessarily so, that although they are only Behinot Nekudot, there is a Behina in them that joins with the Taamimde MA, and a Behina that joins with the Nekudot de MA. The same applies for the other divisions, though all together, they are only Behinot Nekudot de SAG.
Through this connection of MA with it, these Nekudot have now connected and became Nukvin (pl. for Nukva) to them. That reason they are called Melachim, from the word Malchut, indicating that they’ve become Nukvato MA de Alephin.
